title: 2.0 ships without SplatKit: the 3D-scene node pack leaves the engine lock until MPI-623 ships
description: MPI-595 A7, Fabio 2026-09-27: 3D scene is not in 2.0. ComfyUI-SplatKit (and click, which only it needs) installs on every user's engine for a feature with no surface. Take it out of node_lock/nodesDeps/python_deps; MPI-623 restores it when it ships. ComfyUI-Mickmumpitz-Nodes STAYS: the shipped Outpaint Flow uses MickmumpitzPanoHarmonizeBoundary.
